# Right result, right moment: monitoring that helps radiology AI deliver

> Personal, non-commercial research page of Sergey Morozov (MD, PhD, MPH). Topic: monitoring that helps deployed radiology AI deliver everyday value: what worked and what needs work in a 20-center network over 4.5 years, five things any department can measure, and a three-layer monitoring set (machine time, workflow time, radiologist perception). Main source: Morozov S, Heracleous N, Novarina O, Korka D, Dufour B, Thouly C, Rizk B. Artificial Intelligence Latency, Report Turnaround Time, and Adoption in a Multivendor Artificial Intelligence Ecosystem: A Multisite Observational Study. J Am Coll Radiol. 2026. doi:10.1016/j.jacr.2026.09.026. Accepted manuscript, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.

## Documents
- [Research page](https://aimonitoring.drsergeymorozov.com/): what works, what needs work, five actions for departments, monitoring set in three layers, talks
- [Accepted manuscript, HTML](https://aimonitoring.drsergeymorozov.com/manuscript/): full text with tables
- [Accepted manuscript, Markdown](https://aimonitoring.drsergeymorozov.com/manuscript/manuscript.md): full text for machine reading
- [Accepted manuscript, PDF](https://aimonitoring.drsergeymorozov.com/morozov-jacr-2026-accepted-manuscript.pdf)
- [Video explainer, 3.5 min](https://aimonitoring.drsergeymorozov.com/video/jacr-explainer.mp4), [transcript](https://aimonitoring.drsergeymorozov.com/video/transcript.md): narrated by Sergey Morozov

## Notes
- Observational study: associations, not causation.
- Cite the published journal article: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jacr.2026.09.026
- Open-source code too-late-rate (Apache-2.0): https://github.com/spmoroz/too-late-rate ; archived release: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23141600
